title: Brain extracellular matrix remodelling in health and neuropsychiatric disorders
title_zh: 健康与神经精神障碍中的脑细胞外基质重塑
abstract: The neural extracellular matrix (ECM) is increasingly recognized as an active regulator of brain function and an important contributor to the pathogenesis of neuropsychiatric disorders. This Review examines ECM organization, function and adaptive remodelling in the healthy brain and synthesizes evidence for its pathophysiological alterations in schizophrenia, major depressive disorder and bipolar disorder. Based on findings from human studies and animal models, we propose an ECM-extended conceptual framework of major psychiatric diseases in which polygenic liability, stress exposure and neuroinflammatory signalling converge to remodel the ECM in circuits supporting reward processing, emotion regulation, cognitive control and social cognition. In this model, an early phase of protease-dominant ECM loosening destabilizes microcircuits composed of parvalbumin-expressing inhibitory neurons and principal cells whereas later reactive ECM rebuilding stabilizes dysfunctional network states and contributes to disease persistence, relapse and treatment resistance. This framework positions the ECM as a central hub of genetic, glial, synaptic and systems-level pathogenesis and suggests avenues for the development of ECM-sensitive biomarkers and ECM-directed interventions that may improve the treatment of these disorders. Brain extracellular matrix (ECM) shapes neuronal physiology and function. In this Review, Dityatev and colleagues describe the organization, function and remodelling of the ECM in the healthy brain and consider how altered ECM function may contribute to the pathogenesis of neuropsychiatric disorders.
abstract_zh: 神经细胞外基质（ECM）越来越被认为是大脑功能的活性调节因子，也是神经精神障碍发病机制的重要参与因素。本综述探讨健康大脑中 ECM 的组织、功能及适应性重塑，并综合了其在精神分裂症、重度抑郁障碍和双相障碍中病理生理学改变的证据。基于人类研究和动物模型的发现，我们提出一种 ECM 扩展的主要精神疾病概念框架，其中多基因易感性、压力暴露和神经炎症信号作用收敛，重塑与奖赏处理、情绪调节、认知控制和社会认知相关的回路中的 ECM。在该模型中，早期的蛋白酶优势 ECM 松弛阶段会去稳定由丝裂原活化蛋白激酶表达性抑制神经元和主要细胞组成的微回路，而后期的反应性 ECM 重建则稳定了功能失调的网络状态，并促成疾病的持续性、复发和治疗抵抗。该框架将 ECM 定位为遗传、胶质、突触和系统水平发病机制的中心枢纽，并提出了开发 ECM 敏感性生物标志物和 ECM 导向干预的途径，这可能改善这些疾病的治疗。脑细胞外基质（ECM）塑造神经元生理与功能。在本综述中，Dityatev 及其同事描述了健康大脑中 ECM 的组织、功能和重塑，并考虑了 ECM 功能改变如何可能促成神经精神障碍的发病机制。
